evidence.title: ASEAN, Hong Kong, China sign protocol to strengthen investment rules
evidence.body: [e001:f01] ASM, Philippine Canadian Inquirer September 22, 2026 Photo courtesy: ASEAN 2026 PH | Facebook ASEAN and Hong Kong, China have signed the First Protocol to Amend the ASEAN-Hong Kong, China Investment Agreement, introducing clearer rules aimed at improving certainty and predictability for investors on both sides. [e001:f02] The protocol was signed on September 20 in Manila ahead of the 10th ASEAN Economic Ministers-Hong Kong, China Consultation at the Philippine International Convention Center. [e001:f03] The signing involved Philippine Trade Secretary Ma. [e001:f04] Cristina Roque, Hong Kong Under Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Bernard Chan, and Thailand Deputy Prime Minister and Commerce Minister Suphajee Suthumpun. [e001:f05] The amendment incorporates schedules of reservations into the existing investment agreement, allowing provisions on national treatment and most-favoured-nation treatment to take effect. [e001:f06] According to the Hong Kong government, the change will allow Hong Kong enterprises and their investments in non-services sectors to receive treatment no less favourable than that given to local or other foreign enterprises, subject to the listed reservations. [e001:f07] The protocol supplements the existing ASEAN-Hong Kong Free Trade Agreement and Investment Agreement, which cover areas including trade in goods and services, investment, economic cooperation and dispute settlement. [e001:f08] The agreements entered fully into force in February 2021. [e001:f09] ASEAN said the latest amendment is intended to create a more transparent, predictable and business-friendly investment environment between the regional bloc and Hong Kong. [e001:f10] Hong Kong’s Commerce and Economic Development Bureau said ASEAN has been Hong Kong’s third-largest destination for outward direct investment for four consecutive years, with a stock of HK$671.2 billion. [e001:f11] The protocol also forms part of continuing work to strengthen investment ties between Hong Kong and ASEAN’s 10 participating member states: Brunei, Cambodia, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam. [e001:f12] An extension of the free trade and investment agreements to Timor-Leste, ASEAN’s 11th member, remains subject to ASEAN’s internal procedures. [e001:f13] Hong Kong and ASEAN said they will continue working toward the protocol’s early implementation after the parties complete the required procedures. evidence.title: Asean and Japan agree to strengthen supply chain amid global risks
evidence.body: [e002:f01] MANILA (Bernama-PNA): Asean and Japan are strengthening cooperation on supply chain resilience, energy security and regional economic stability amid rising geopolitical tensions and volatility in global energy markets, Philippine News Agency (PNA) reported. [e002:f02] The issues were discussed at the 32nd Asean Economic Ministers-Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry Consultation in Pasay City on Sunday, co-chaired by Trade Secretary Ma. [e002:f03] Cristina Roque and Japan's Minister of Economy, Trade and Industry Akazawa Ryosei. [e002:f04] The meeting noted that rising geopolitical tensions, trade-related uncertainties and regional conflicts continue to undermine the stability and predictability of the international economic environment, creating challenges for businesses, particularly micro, small and medium-sized enterprises. [e002:f05] It also noted increased volatility in global energy markets, including risks to key energy supply routes in West Asia and straits used for international navigation, and the potential implications for global supply chains. [e002:f06] In response, Asean and Japanese ministers stressed the need to strengthen cooperation on supply chain resilience, energy security, regional stability and global resilience. [e002:f07] Japan's Partnership on Wide Energy and Resources Resilience and the realisation of the Asia Zero Emission Community 2.0 were also discussed. [e002:f08] Japan proposed cooperation in key sectors, including semiconductors, critical minerals, biofuels and the circular economy, to strengthen regional economic resilience. [e002:f09] The meeting further welcomed progress in implementing the Future Design and Action Plan of Innovative and Sustainable ASEAN-Japan Economic Co-Creation 2023-2033, which serves as a long-term framework for advancing economic relations. [e002:f10] The plan focuses on cyber-physical connectivity, open innovation, human capital development and sustainability. [e002:f11] On trade, the ministers reaffirmed the importance of the ASEAN-Japan Comprehensive Economic Partnership (AJCEP) as a foundation of ASEAN-Japan economic relations and welcomed efforts to improve its utilisation, including the completion of the transposition of product-specific rules into the Harmonised System 2022. [e002:f12] They also welcomed progress towards a possible upgrade of the AJCEP and the commencement of a joint feasibility study by the Economic Research Institute for ASEAN and East Asia, including possible measures to strengthen supply chain resilience. [e002:f13] The meeting noted that two-way merchandise trade between ASEAN and Japan reached US$245.4 billion in 2025, while Japanese foreign direct investment (FDI) into ASEAN totalled US$9.5 billion during the same year. [e002:f14] The figures placed Japan among ASEAN's five largest trading partners and five largest sources of FDI in 2025. -- BERNAMA-PNA Follow us on our official WhatsApp channel for breaking news alerts and key updates! evidence.title: 中国：規制前に北京でドローン売却急増、中古価格は下落
evidence.body: [e003:f01] 11月15日から市内で民生用ドローン（無人機）の所持・飛行が原則禁止されるのを前に、所有者が一斉に処分を進めているためだ。 [e003:f02] 一部では買取価格が従来に比べて4割程度下落したとされ、世界最大級の民生用ドローンメーカー、大疆創新（DJI）への影響を懸念する声も聞かれる。 [e003:f03] 香港メディアの星島日報が21日付で伝えた。 [e003:f04] 報道によると、新規制の発表後、中古品取引サイトなどでドローンの出品が急増。 [e003:f05] 短期間に売り手が集中したことで需給バランスが崩れ、買取価格が大幅に低下している。 [e003:f06] 市民の1人は保有していたドローン5台を手放し、購入価格に比べて数千人民元の損失が出たと話した。 [e003:f07] 大量の売却が続けば、中古価格の低下が新品市場にも波及すると懸念されている。 [e003:f08] 一方、DJIは売上高の約8割を海外で稼ぐとされ、北京単独の規制による直接的な業績への影響は限定的との見方もある。 [e003:f09] ただ、北京の措置を受けて他都市でも規制強化の動きが広がれば、中国の民生用ドローン市場全体の需要を冷やしかねない。 [e003:f10] 北京市は11月15日から、市全域で民生用ドローンの所持や飛行を全面的に禁止する方針だ。 [e003:f11] 6月に市中心部で起きた高層ビルへの小型飛行機の衝突事件を受け、首都の空域防衛を強化する。 [e003:f12] 10月末までに指定拠点で売却すれば取引価格の30％、1台当たり最大3000人民元（約7万円）を補助する方針。 [e003:f13] 11月1～14日は補助率を15％、上限を1500人民元に引き下げる。 [e003:f14] 廃棄や北京市外への移転も選択できる。 [e003:f15] 内容についてのお問い合わせは＜info@＞まで。 [e003:f16] 関連ニュース 新世界発展が九龍ハイアット持ち分売却か、資産再編の一環 台湾・香港 産業・企業 ( 2026/09/22 15:33 ) 4～6月中国PC出荷11％増、レノボ首位維持＝オムディア 産業・企業 電子・半導体 ( 2026/09/22 15:07 ) アリババが「中国最強」AI半導体発表、前世代比で性能3倍 産業・企業 電子・半導体 ( 2026/09/22 14:44 ) 中国：老板電器がiTronics買収、欧米販路とセンシング技術獲得 産業・企業 ( 2026/09/22 13:22 ) BYDが西安で8000人超を採用、増産・輸出拡大で人員確保 産業・企業 労働 ( 2026/09/22 12:17 ) 中国フレキシブルプリント基板各社、折りたたみスマホ向け増産 産業・企業 電子・半導体 ( 2026/09/22 11:45 ) 安徽・陽産古楼 お知らせ 2026-09-15 国慶節休刊のお知らせ 2026-07-28 お盆休刊のお知らせ 2026-06-02 端午節休刊のお知らせ 一覧を見る 人気のニュース 1 中国：消費財「以旧換新」販売額88兆円、4.94億人に恩恵 2 中国：六フッ化タングステンひっ迫、4月輸出価格は前月比204％高 3 ナガオカ大連子会社が大口受注、契約額5.7億円 4 中国製造業で進むAI「無人化工場」、全工程の自動化で生産性向上 5 八達通がPayPayと連携、日本実店舗で香港ドル決済可能に 人気の産業レポート 1 中国：電子(26年5月） 2 アジア電子・半導体ウィークリー20260911 3 《Basic》亜州ビジネス自動車20260907 4 中国：保険(26年7月) 5 中国：電子(26年7月）。

What's New in Quantum Computing? Nasdaq Explores the Sector's Rise in Innovation and Investment
evidence.body: [e001:f01] There has been an increase in companies developing the technology entering the public markets in recent years, private investment is accelerating, and [Nasdaq Global Indexes has added quantum computing](https:// to one of its leading innovation indexes. [e001:f02] According to [McKinsey research](https:// quantum computing could generate multi-billion-dollar enterprise value over the next decade, with an economic impact that could reach approximately $2.7 trillion by 2035. [e001:f03] "Quantum technology helps organizations solve problems that are currently costly, difficult, or impractical using classical computers," said Ilaria Sangalli, Head of Index Insights for EMEA at Nasdaq, who authored the index team's research on the quantum sub-theme. [e001:f04] Fifteen Nasdaq-listed U.S. companies specializing in AI and quantum computing hardware and software, have a combined market capitalization of about $3.78 trillion. [e001:f05] Three-quarters of those companies have listed since 2020, including the recent listings of D-Wave Quantum, Quantinuum, and IQM Quantum Computers, with the largest wave arriving in 2021 and a new cohort emerging in the last two years._[1]_ The pattern resembles earlier cycles in AI, cloud computing, and cybersecurity, when investors began to treat each as a distinct category. [e001:f06] Since its launch on November 12, 2018, NYGBIG has delivered a total return of approximately 384% (22.8% on an annualized basis). [e001:f07] Since July 2023, NYGBIG generated a total return of 139% (33% on an annualized basis), outperforming the Nasdaq-100®, broader U.S. equities, and several established AI benchmarks._[2]_ Of the 1,181 companies with patent activity related to NYGBIG's sub-themes, 247 held patents connected to quantum computing. [e001:f08] "The two technologies may reinforce one another rather than develop independently," Sangalli said. [Investment continues to grow.](https:// Quantum technology startups attracted $12.6 billion in venture and private funding in 2025, more than six times the 2024 level, with roughly 90% directed at quantum computing specifically. [e001:f09] Governments are engaged, viewing the technology as critical for national security and cryptography; the U.S. government announced about $2 billion in quantum commitments in May 2026 and has taken minority stakes in leading companies. [e001:f10] Public money made up about one-third of total investment in 2024 and just 3% in 2025. [e001:f11] Sangalli expects interest in quantum to build as more commercial use cases emerge, with investors gaining exposure through a mix of pure-play quantum companies and larger technology firms investing in the technology through R&D spending, including patent development. [e001:f12] "It's much more." _**Sources:**_ _[1] Source: Pitchbook and Factset_ _[2] Nasdaq and Bloomberg_ _[3] Nasdaq AI Team, Nasdaq, IFI Claims. [e001:f14] Such forward-looking statements include, but are not limited to, statements regarding the potential economic impact and commercial applications of quantum computing, future investment and investor interest, the convergence of quantum computing and artificial intelligence, the development of quantum technologies, and anticipated changes in the composition or boundaries of the technology sector. evidence.title: S&P Global to Acquire OpenZeppelin
evidence.body: [e002:f01] The transaction complements S&P Global’s risk assessment and ecosystem development capabilities in digital asset markets, enhancing its ability to create the next generation of onchain security assessments, benchmarks, and deliver essential intelligence as capital markets transition onchain. [e002:f02] Founded in 2015, OpenZeppelin combines leading onchain security assessments and secure development services with one of the world’s leading open-source smart contract libraries. [e002:f03] OpenZeppelin Contracts underpin over $37 trillion in value transferred, including the vast majority of the largest stablecoins and tokenized funds, and the company has conducted 900+ security engagements for the protocols and institutions defining digital asset markets. [e002:f04] OpenZeppelin’s technology and expertise are trusted by decentralized finance (DeFi) and traditional financial institutions to secure the onchain infrastructure that increasingly underpins digital assets. [e002:f05] “Our digital assets strategy centers on bringing trusted data, benchmarks and transparent risk assessment to markets as they move onchain,” said Yann Le Pallec, President, S&P Global Ratings . [e002:f06] “As digital assets and tokenized markets continue to mature, OpenZeppelin’s technology and expertise will complement our smart contract and onchain technology risk assessment capabilities, giving traditional financial institutions and DeFi-native companies alike the confidence to build and transact in this new environment.” The acquisition will expand S&P Global’s risk assessment capabilities into the onchain technology-risk layer and as an extension to onchain financial products, while S&P Global’s trusted brand, deep institutional relationships, and global distribution accelerate OpenZeppelin’s reach into traditional finance. [e002:f07] “OpenZeppelin’s standards, technology, and expertise already power the infrastructure behind the world’s leading stablecoins, tokenized funds, DeFi protocols, and onchain markets,” said Demian Brener, CEO, OpenZeppelin . [e002:f08] “With S&P Global, that foundation reaches a broader set of organizations entering this market, as well as the blockchain networks and DeFi protocols gaining institutional adoption.” OpenZeppelin will continue to operate as its own business unit under the OpenZeppelin name. [e002:f09] Brener will continue to lead the business, reporting to Yann Le Pallec, President, S&P Global Ratings. [e002:f10] Jefferies LLC is serving as financial advisor to S&P Global; Clifford Chance is acting as S&P Global’s legal advisor. [e002:f11] FT Partners is serving as exclusive financial and strategic advisor to OpenZeppelin; Cooley is acting as OpenZeppelin’s legal advisor. evidence.title: Fed Raises Rates as Kevin Warsh Shifts Away From Fixed Policy Guidance
evidence.body: [e003:f01] The first Federal Reserve rate hike in three years came as a surprise to some investors, even though futures markets had priced in that scenario in advance. [e003:f02] This gap between the expectations of different market participants may reflect the approach of new Fed Chair Kevin Warsh, who does not support rigid guidance for future policy. [e003:f03] Based on data from Reuters The decision to raise the rate by 0.25 percentage points had effectively been priced in after Warsh’s speech at the annual conference in Jackson Hole in August. [e003:f04] Following the release of August data on consumer and producer inflation, the probability of such a move settled at around 90%, as the figures showed insufficient progress toward the Fed’s 2% target. [e003:f05] This figure was down from 75% a month earlier, but it still meant that 52% of survey participants were not forecasting a policy change just one week before the Fed’s decision. [e003:f06] The differences among investors may reflect precisely this model of communication. [e003:f07] At the same time, some market participants may have assumed that Warsh and other Fed officials would yield to political pressure and leave rates unchanged. [e003:f08] The latest update to the projections showed that the median estimate from Fed officials envisions core personal consumption expenditures inflation returning to the 2% target only in 2029. [e003:f09] The Fed moves away from rigid forecasting models A key reference point for the interest-rate market remains the so-called neutral rate. [e003:f10] The median forecast for the long-term neutral rate rose last week to 3.2%, the highest level in a decade. [e003:f11] No, I do not. – Kevin Warsh According to the Fed chair, the rate hike merely removed “a dose of stimulus.” This suggests that he does not yet consider 3.875% to be a neutral level. [e003:f12] Warsh wants to assess the impact of monetary policy on the economy, but he does not want to tie his decisions to models or a predetermined path. [e003:f13] The absence of forward guidance and Warsh’s dismissive attitude toward the long-term rate forecast create conditions for rates to rise gradually. [e003:f14] That is what we expected after the abandonment of soft guidance for forecasting policy. – Tim Duy, economist Ultimately, the Fed may shift toward an approach in which decisions depend more on the current state of the economy and its near-term outlook than on predetermined parameters. [e003:f15] This increasingly looks like a new regime and a more significant departure from past practice than previously thought. – Jonathan Pingle, economist Even if the new model proves more effective, it will likely widen the gap between investors and financial markets over the Fed’s future decisions. [e003:f16] The Federal Reserve is expected to raise interest rates on September 16, 2026, as persistent inflation, rising Treasury yields and political pressure test its independence.

evidence.title: 米国株トレンド（9月22日）：Metaが11%急騰、AMDの時価総額が1兆米ドルを突破、ナスダック総合指数が過去最高値を更新
evidence.body: [e004:f01] S&P 500指数は1.49％上昇の7764.70ポイント、ナスダック指数は2.26％上昇の27122.090ポイント、ダウ平均株価は0.71％上昇の52048.83ポイントを付けた。 [e004:f02] Meta傘下のAIエージェント「Muse」が米国App Store無料アプリランキングで1位を獲得し、AIエージェントへの熱機運がすぐにCPUおよびAIハードウェア銘柄に波及した。 [e004:f03] AMD、インテル、クアルコム、ARMが集団的に大幅上昇し、その中でAMDの時価総額が初めて1兆ドルを突破した。 [e004:f04] 原油価格の大幅下落と10年物米国債利回りが5％を下回る水準まで戻ったことで、高バリュエーションの科技株が資金調達や上昇するための空間も生み出された。 [e004:f05] ナスダック指数が新高記録、フィラデルフィア半導体指数が4.29％上昇 S&P 500指数は1.49％上昇の7764.70ポイント、ナスダック指数は2.26％上昇の27122.090ポイントをつけ史上初の終値高値を記録。 [e004:f06] VIX指数は14.87と小幅に0.41％上昇した。 [e004:f07] フィラデルフィア半導体指数は4.29％上昇し、8月4日以来となる単日で最高のパフォーマンスを記録した。 [e004:f08] Metaが11.43％、テスラが3.03％、NVIDIAが2.30％、Amazonが1.87％、Microsoftが1.59％、Alphabetが1.55％、Appleが0.85％それぞれ上昇した。 [e004:f09] 2年物米国債利回りは小幅に4.751％まで上昇、10年物は約4.5bp低下して4.951％となった。 [e004:f10] WTI原油は4.86％下落し95.43ドル/バレル、ブレント原油は3.62％下落して100ドル台前半へ。 [e004:f11] ビットコインは8万6千ドルを突破して8カ月ぶりの高値を更新、Ethereumも2700ドルを超えた。 [e004:f12] MetaはAMDの重要顧客の一つであり、両社は今年何年にもわたる契約を締結済みで、最大6GW規模のAMD Instinct GPUの導入を計画している。 [e004:f13] マイクロンは2.77％上昇、マウェラーは5.38％上昇、アプリケーション・マテリアルズは4.42％上昇、コーニングは5.89％上昇、ルメンタムは2.53％上昇した。 [e004:f14] 過去1週間、市場はAI安全性に関する議論による急落を経験したばかりだったが、昨夜の反発は単純な底値買いから新たな産業的要因駆動型へ変化しつつある。 [e004:f15] 原油価格が96ドル割れ、10年物米国債が再び5％下に回復 科技株の上昇にはもう一つの重要な背景がある。 [e004:f16] 貿易面では、11月に期限切れとなる関税暫定停止期間の延長与否を決定するに至らず、高度なAIチップの輸出規制についても今回の協議で新たな突破口は見いだせなかった。

evidence.title: The Fed Finally Raised Rates. Now Comes the Hard Part.
evidence.body: [e005:f01] The Fed took a first step, but to restore stability, tightening must continue. [e005:f02] The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) voted unanimously to raise its target range for the federal funds rate by a quarter percentage point to 3.75–4 percent on Wednesday, the first increase since July 2023 . [e005:f03] More importantly, the projections released with Wednesday’s decision suggest that more increases lie ahead. [e005:f04] The decision came as little surprise to market participants: on the eve of the vote, futures markets put the odds of a quarter-point increase above 90 percent. [e005:f05] In July , the FOMC noted that inflation was elevated “in part reflecting supply shocks that have driven price increases in certain sectors, including energy.” That language was nowhere to be found in Wednesday’s release. [e005:f06] The statement made no reference to supply factors, saying only that “Inflation remains elevated,” and the rate increase “will support a timelier return to the Committee’s 2 percent goal,” suggesting that the Fed now sees demand as the primary driver of inflation. [e005:f07] At the post-meeting press conference , Chairman Warsh defended the decision to raise rates on the grounds that the economy “appears to be strengthening,” and that he “would be hard-pressed to describe broad financial conditions as restrictive.” That view, Warsh noted, “was widely shared by the Committee. [e005:f08] So we removed a dose of accommodation.” At his Jackson Hole speech last month, Warsh committed himself to “a monetary policy discipline, not to a decision,” and set the standard he would use to evaluate whether policy is on the right track: “We must be confident that underlying inflation is moving to our objective, clearly and at sufficient speed.” According to Warsh, “the FOMC decided that this standard has not been satisfied,” which is why the Committee decided to raise rates. [e005:f09] The Summary of Economic Projections released with the decision aligns with the FOMC’s decision to remove the supply shock language from Wednesday’s statement. [e005:f10] The decline in July’s PCE print puts the September projection path slightly below June’s, despite the Fed projecting higher inflation. [e005:f11] Nonetheless, prices remain on track to finish the year a full percentage point above where policymakers expected last December. [e005:f12] That’s fine as far as it goes, but the Fed’s credibility depends on policymakers’ decisions and the results that follow. [e005:f13] Most FOMC members expect to raise rates at least once more this year, while four expect two increases by the end of the year. [e005:f14] In other words, Fed officials now anticipate both further tightening and a longer period of higher rates. [e005:f15] But with nominal spending growing at an annualized rate of eight percent in the second quarter, Fed officials must recognize that restoring price stability will require further rate increases. [e005:f16] The test is whether it tightens policy enough to bring inflation back to two percent “clearly and at sufficient speed.” Bryan Cutsinger Dr.

evidence.body: [e006:f01] Spot gold was little changed at $4,342.41 per ounce by 0454 GMT. [e006:f02] US gold futures fell 0.1% to $4,379.30. [e006:f03] Bullion is ​traditionally viewed as a hedge against inflation and geopolitical risks, but its ​appeal tends to wane in a high-interest-rate environment as investors favour ⁠yield-bearing assets. [e006:f04] With US economic data limited this week, investors will focus on comments ​from Fed officials for signs of whether the central bank is leaning toward another ​rate increase in October, as well as on crude oil prices, said Chris Weston, head of research at Pepperstone. [e006:f05] "While crude has come modestly off its recent highs, a reversal higher that builds ​inflation expectations would only intensify the rates story, and gold would likely continue to ​face headwinds," said Weston. [e006:f06] The Fed raised its policy rate by a quarter of a percentage point ‌last ⁠week and flagged more hikes in the coming months. [e006:f07] The US central bank will likely need to hike rates further to lower inflation resulting from strong demand as well as a commodity price shock that has moved beyond oil, St. [e006:f08] Louis Fed President Alberto ​Musalem said, adding ​that it would ⁠be better for the Fed to act sooner than wait. [e006:f09] On the geopolitical front, Houthi fighters pushed to seize strategic heights in Yemen ​to cut off the Red Sea coast from remaining areas held ​by Saudi-backed ⁠forces, after a report that US President Donald Trump had called off American strikes on the group at the last minute. [e006:f10] Oil prices gained for the first time in ⁠five sessions ​as investors awaited developments on potential US-Iran talks ​at the United Nations General Assembly this week. evidence.title: MBA lifts mortgage rate outlook as Fed signals hiking cycle
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Mortgage rates for 30-year fixed-rate loans that meet the underwriting guidelines of Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac are now projected to spend the fourth quarter around 6.8% and remain at that level through next June, the mortgage trade group said late last week. [e001:f02] That compares to prior-month forecasts of 30-year rates averaging 6.7% through the remainder of 2026 and through the duration of 2027. [e001:f03] It is meaningfully higher than July outlooks of 6.5% rates through the end of next year. [e001:f04] Year to date, that reflects a nearly 8% decline from the $760 billion in full-year refinance volume projected by the MBA in January. [e001:f05] Rapidly shifting interest rate outlooks On the purchase side, the MBA’s latest forecast shows volumes hitting about $1.42 trillion in 2026, down from $1.43 trillion forecast in August and $1.44 trillion projected at the start of the year. [e001:f06] The upward revision to mortgage rates and downward revision to lenders’ production volumes followed the Federal Reserve’s unanimous decision last week to raise the federal funds rate by a quarter of a percentage point. [e001:f07] That increased the benchmark overnight lending rate for banks to a target range between 3.75% and 4%. [e001:f08] Fed officials also overwhelmingly signaled that one additional quarter-point hike was on tap for 2026, with a third increase potentially occurring in the first half of 2027. [e001:f09] Treasury yields to which 30-year mortgage rates are benchmarked. [e001:f10] Yields on 10-year Treasurys crossed 5% last week for the first time since 2007 — up from around 4% in late February — as surging corporate bond issuance, concerns about federal deficits and higher inflation expectations led investors to demand higher returns. [e001:f11] Treasury yields expected to stay elevated Fed Chair Kevin Warsh told reporters last week that the central bank’s preferred inflation gauge, the personal consumption expenditures price index, was running at around 3.6% in August. [e001:f12] The PCE index has been above the Fed’s 2% target for more than five years but has sharply accelerated since the Iran war began in late February. [e001:f13] After forecasting in January that 10-year Treasury yields would end 2026 around 4.2%, the MBA’s latest projections show the 10-year yielding 4.8% at the end of this year and falling only slightly to 4.7% by the end of 2027. [e001:f14] Mortgage rates hovered just under 7% during the first two weeks of September, according to MBA and Freddie Mac rate indexes. [e001:f15] That means the MBA’s forecast for 30-year rates averaging 6.8% in the fourth quarter would require some softening in Treasury yields and investors’ inflation outlooks over the coming weeks and months. [e001:f16] Whereas MBA economists see 10-year yields declining to 4.7% by the start of 2028, economists at the government-sponsored mortgage investor maintained their prior-month outlook from September.

evidence.title: いまさら聞けない「米国の雇用が世界経済にとって最も重要」なワケ…崩れたら株が「大暴落」（クーリエ・ジャポン）
evidence.body: [e002:f01] 【見る】プロこうして「上がる株」を判断する 分析に「本当に役立つ」指標の名前 【第3回】プロはこうして「上がる株」を判断する 分析に「本当に役立つ」指標の名前 なぜ投資には米国の指標が重要なのか ──著書の『武器になる経済指標』の冒頭は、米国の指標からはじまっていますが、なぜ米国から解説がはじまるのでしょうか。 [e002:f02] 米国は非常に大きな経済規模を持ち、1ヵ国で世界のGDPのおよそ4分の1を占めています。 [e002:f03] 世界中の投資家が米国の雇用統計を注視している理由としてポイントを挙げると、米国のGDPの約7割を個人消費が占めているからです。 [e002:f04] つまり、世界のGDPの約4分の1を占める米国経済の約7割が個人消費によるもので、これを単純に掛け合わせれば、米国の個人消費だけで世界経済の約2割を占める計算になります。 [e002:f05] では、米国の個人消費はどのような状況で伸びるのかと言えば、雇用が増加し失業率が安定しているときです。 [e002:f06] したがって、米国の雇用統計を確認されおけば、世界経済がどの方向に向かっているのかを、かなりの範囲まで把握できるのです。 [e002:f07] 日本では「令和のブラックマンデー」などと呼ばれましたが、その直前には、米国の雇用情勢が悪化しているのではないかという懸念が広がっていました。 [e002:f08] 当時は米国の失業率が上昇しはじめるなど、雇用市場の弱さを示す兆候が出ていたため、市場参加者が一斉にリスクを回避し、資金を引き上げる事態になりました。 [e002:f09] しかし、雇用統計も決して完璧なデータではありません。 [e002:f10] 米国ほど人口規模の大きな国で、毎月の雇用者数が10万人増えたのか、15万人増えたのかという違いは、誤差の範囲です。 [e002:f11] 雇用統計の速報値には一定のノイズが含まれていて、2ヵ月ほどかけて修正された結果、実際にはそこまで「雇用が弱い」という現象はありませんでした。 [e002:f12] 最近では、むしろ雇用者数の勢いが戻りつつあるので、現時点では、最も重要な米国の雇用と個人消費が大きく崩れる事態には至っていません。 [e002:f13] 米国の雇用統計が堅調である間は、中長期的に見れば、世界経済や世界の企業収益全体が改善していく可能性が高く、それに伴って株価も上昇していくと考えられます。 [e002:f14] 米国の雇用が減少方向に向かいそうだから、株をすべて売却するべきかと言えば、そう単純な話でもありません。 [e002:f15] しかも単なる景気を下支えするだけでなく、その後は需要を強く刺激する方向に政策が動いたため、結果として株価が大きく上昇する展開にもなりました。 [e002:f16] 次ページは：「AIバブル」が「ITバブル」と異なる理由 前へ 1 2 次へ 1 / 2ページ 【関連記事】 2030年、日本円は「70円台」の超円高に…日本人だけが気づかない「為替」の意外な盲点 「絶対にやめろ」の忠告を無視…1日で2400万円を失った投資家の末路 給料が上がっても喜べない…日本を破壊する「賃金上昇」の意外な落とし穴 プロはこうして「上がる株」を判断している…企業分析に「本当に役立つ」指標の名前【エコノミストが明かす】 日本株「爆上がり」のウラで、賢い人が「避けている」投資先の名前。
